why: Restores the exact behaviour issue #325 was filed to remove: one message for every way startup can fail. Before this change `showFailure` printed NO_WEBGL_MESSAGE -- "this game needs WebGL, try another browser" -- for the capability gate, for `createAppShell` failing to resolve storage, for a renderer that got its context and then failed initialising, and for a match that failed from a HUD click. It was true for the first and a GUESS for the rest, and the guess was actionable: a player whose storage was blocked was told to go and change browsers over a graphics feature that was working. Nothing throws under this mutation and the screen still looks correct, which is why it needs a test that reads which state was chosen rather than that a state was.
killedBy: boot: the page-scoped settings owner shows the error page when building it throws, rather than failing silently
boot: the message itself classifies each cause into its own state, and guesses at nothing
